conventions.commits: Conventional commits (feat(core): ..., feat(lang): ...), GPG signed (git log %G? shows a signature on recent commits) and Signed-off-by DCO trailers (e.g. dbc2971 Swift commit). commitlint via .commitlintrc.yml.
conventions.testing: Unit tests inline in each languages/*.rs under #[cfg(test)] (parse helper + stack traversal + Query::new on ELEMENT_QUERY); integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs and semantic_correctness.rs using TempDir and analyze_file; MCP-level tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/ using common::call_tool_raw and make_test_analyzer. CI runs cargo nextest with llvm-cov (ci.yml:177-183).
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --locked --profile ci -- -D warnings -W clippy::cognitive_complexity (ci.yml:135-137); workspace lints deny unwrap_used, expect_used, undocumented_unsafe_blocks; cargo deny check advisories licenses bans (ci.yml:211); REUSE compliance; SPDX header on every file.
conventions.error_handling: Handlers return Option/Vec and never panic; bounds-checked get_node_text (languages/mod.rs) returns Option; errors surface as ParserError::UnsupportedLanguage / QueryError from parser.rs; tests use expect/unwrap only under the cfg_attr test exemption.

patterns: Registry: each language is a module with pub const ELEMENT_QUERY/CALL_QUERY/REFERENCE_QUERY/IMPORT_QUERY/DEFUSE_QUERY plus optional handlers, registered in languages/mod.rs get_language_info() and get_ts_language().

Java template: ELEMENT_QUERY captures (method_declaration name: (identifier) @method_name) @function and (class_declaration name: (identifier) @class_name) @class; DEFUSE_QUERY uses write./writeread./read. prefixes.

Inheritance: swift.rs and java.rs walk children to find base/interface nodes and emit prefixed strings (extends X / implements X / conforms X) which parser_elements.rs:398-402 stores in ClassInfo.inherits.
Element name resolution is capture-driven (func_name/method_name/class_name/type_name), so PHP can reuse the contract without extract_function_name handlers (see issue scope).
Lazy query compilation keyed by supported_languages(); a language absent from that list cannot be analyzed (parser.rs:191, 222).
Extension lookup via EXTENSION_MAP drives language_for_extension, the JSON schema file-extension pattern (schema_helpers.rs:58-69) and metrics export, so one EXTENSION_MAP row wires all three.

constraints: Maintainer note in issue #1864 body: the maintainers are implementing this in-house and external pull requests for this issue are not being accepted; treat this as a scouting artifact, not a contribution plan.
LANGUAGE_PHP (mixed HTML/PHP) must be used, not LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY; the issue requires a mixed .php file with zero ERROR nodes. Verified: the mixed sample parses with no ERROR or MISSING nodes.
tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 depends on tree-sitter-language 0.1 and dev-depends on tree-sitter 0.27; workspace tree-sitter is 0.27.1 (Cargo.lock 0.27.2), so the LanguageFn .into() path is compatible.
New Cargo.lock entries must be at least 7 days old (AGENTS.md); publish date of tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 was not verified in this clone.
EXTENSION_MAP addition automatically changes the JSON schema pattern and metrics extension list; the schemars test (lang.rs) checks every EXTENSION_MAP entry.
Scope limits from the issue: no extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type; no .phtml/.inc/.module/.php5 extensions; no tool handler or schema changes.
Commits must be GPG signed and DCO signed off (issue acceptance criteria).

approaches.name: A: Minimal Java-mirror handler (recommended)
approaches.description: Add crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class/interface/trait/enum declarations), CALL_QUERY (function/member/scoped call names), REFERENCE_QUERY (name and qualified_name in type positions), IMPORT_QUERY (namespace_use_declaration), DEFUSE_QUERY (assignment, augmented, update, simple_parameter, static, global, read name), and extract_inheritance walking base_clause and class_interface_clause children. Wire tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE_PHP into mod.rs (both matches), add php to lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP and supported_languages(), add Cargo deps, README and ARCHITECTURE rows, and inline plus one integration test.
pros: Follows the issue scope exactly (five constants plus extract_inheritance)
Element capture names reuse the existing name-resolution contract, so no extract_function_name handler is needed
Each query was compiled and matched against a real PHP sample with the grammar CLI in this session
cons: DEFUSE_QUERY is a heuristic: read.usage (name) also matches function, class and method names, same as Java; write-then-read dedup relies on byte offsets
Requires adding supported_languages() entry that css and yaml omit; easy to miss
Cargo.lock churn plus new transitive tree-sitter-language crate

approaches.name: B: Minimal registry-only (no inheritance, no defuse)
approaches.description: Same as A but set defuse_query: None and extract_inheritance: None, with only ELEMENT, CALL and IMPORT queries.
pros: Smallest diff, lowest risk of query drift
cons: Does not meet issue acceptance (inheritance and defuse criteria)
Def-use output for .php is silently empty (parser_elements.rs:850-852)
Leaves php inheritance unavailable to analyze_file consumers

approaches.name: C: Full PHP-aware handler with namespace-qualified names and handlers
approaches.description: Approach A plus extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver and find_receiver_type handlers, qualified_name normalisation (strip leading backslash), and a PHP-only grammar fallback.
pros: Richer receiver information for future method-level tools
cons: Explicitly out of scope; the issue notes these handlers have no consumer since #1807
Adds maintenance without a current consumer

recommendation: Approach A. It meets every acceptance criterion in issue #1864, reuses the element capture contract (no extra handlers), and its queries were compiled and matched with the tree-sitter 0.27.2 CLI against tree-sitter-php 0.25.2. DEFUSE_QUERY is needed by the issue scope and so that def-use output for .php is not silently empty; it is an Option in LanguageInfo, so it is not a compile-time requirement. Use LANGUAGE_PHP (not PHP_ONLY) because the mixed-template acceptance criterion depends on it. Add php to supported_languages() explicitly, since css and yaml omit it and analysis would fail with UnsupportedLanguage.

inheritance_walk_citation:
Verified against php/src/node-types.json (identical in the 0.25.2 crate and the repo master) and php/src/grammar.json (common/define-grammar.js source):
- class_declaration: fields are exactly attributes, body (declaration_list), name (name). No superclass/interfaces field exists.
- class_declaration rule: optional(field('attributes')), repeat(_modifier), keyword('class'), field('name', reserved('classes', $.name)), optional($.base_clause), optional($.class_interface_clause), field('body', $.declaration_list).
- base_clause rule: seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name)). Unnamed child of class_declaration (not a field), so child_by_field_name cannot reach it; walk node.children() and match kind()=="base_clause"; its named children are name | qualified_name | relative_name (hidden _name supertype, appear directly).
- class_interface_clause rule: seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name)). Same walk: child kind()=="class_interface_clause"; named children are the implemented names.
- Parse check (tree-sitter 0.27.2 CLI on the 0.25.2 grammar): `abstract class Animal extends Base implements Speaker, \Countable {}` yields base_clause(name "Base") then class_interface_clause(name "Speaker", qualified_name "\Countable"). Qualified names keep the leading backslash in source text.
- interface_declaration: optional base_clause (rule base_clause, the extends list; multiple names allowed, e.g. `interface Runner extends Movable, Named`).
- enum_declaration: optional primitive_type (backing type) then optional class_interface_clause (implements); no base_clause.
- trait_declaration: no base_clause or class_interface_clause.
Proposed handler: iterate node.children(&mut cursor); for kind base_clause push "extends {text}" per named child; for kind class_interface_clause push "implements {text}" per named child; return Vec (empty when neither exists).
